name: Pondicherry
description: Sea air, slow mornings, and streets made for wandering.
detail: Follow the coast toward White Town, pause along the promenade, and leave time for a café stop. Make this your own unhurried weekend.
imageAlt: Aerial view of Pondicherry’s promenade beside the sea

name: Mahabalipuram
description: Stone stories and a little time by the sea.
detail: Explore the town's carved monuments and coastal streets at your own pace. Check official site hours before travelling.

name: Kodaikanal
description: Trade the city rush for mist and mountain air.
detail: Plan an unhurried hill escape with lakeside walks, viewpoints, and time to pause. Allow extra time for hill roads and changing weather.
imageAlt: Green hills and valleys in southern India

name: Yelagiri
description: A quiet hill break, with room to slow down.
detail: Keep the itinerary light: a walk, a viewpoint, and a relaxed overnight stay. Verify local road and weather conditions before departure.
imageAlt: Lush green hills in southern India

name: Thanjavur
description: Temple courtyards, art, and an enduring history.
detail: Build a cultural break around temple architecture and the region's art traditions. Leave time to explore beyond a single stop.
imageAlt: Detailed temple architecture in Tamil Nadu

name: Rameswaram
description: Island roads and wide-open coastal skies.
detail: Plan a coastal journey with room for local landmarks and quiet stretches by the water. Confirm access and weather before heading to exposed coastal areas.
imageAlt: Pondicherry coastline, illustrative of a coastal escape
